about_seo_title: About Istqrar | Food Safety & Quality Control Experts
about_seo_description: Learn about Istqrar's mission, vision, goals, and international food safety standards (HACCP, ISO 22000, ISO 9001) across Saudi Arabia.
services_seo_title: Our Services | Istqrar Food Safety & Operational Quality
services_seo_description: Explore Istqrar's 8 specialized quality control services: certified audits, ISO & HACCP implementation, field training, and third-party inspection.
subscriptions_seo_title: Subscription Packages | Istqrar Quality Management Plans
subscriptions_seo_description: Compare Istqrar's food safety and quality control subscription packages tailored for restaurants, cafes, and enterprises.
contact_seo_title: Contact Us | Istqrar Quality & Food Safety
contact_seo_description: Get in touch with Istqrar in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for quality control audits, ISO/HACCP consulting, and subscription inquiries.
about_page_subtitle: Turning food safety and quality compliance into sustainable operational excellence and measurable profit.
about_story_extended: Founded in Riyadh in 2025, Istqrar bridges the gap between regulatory compliance and day-to-day restaurant, cafe, and food-enterprise operations. By replacing fragmented checks with structured digital monitoring and certified field audits, we help facilities cut waste, eliminate recurring operational errors, and turn quality costs into net profit.
about_pillars_subtitle: How we deliver consistent field impact across every branch.
pillar_1_detail: Tailored operational plans and scalable quality governance built for single-branch cafes, growing chains, and multi-region food enterprises.
pillar_2_detail: Structured inspections aligned with SFDA, municipal regulations, and international food safety frameworks to minimize violations and build customer trust.
pillar_3_detail: Actionable standard operating procedures (SOPs), corrective action tracking, and measurable KPIs for kitchen and service teams.
pillar_4_detail: Certified quality observers who work directly inside your facility—coaching staff on-site during live operations rather than delivering generic checklists.
certifications_subtitle: Our inspection checklists and operational frameworks are modeled on globally recognized quality and food safety standards.
cert_haccp_desc: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points to identify, monitor, and prevent biological, chemical, and physical food hazards across receiving, storage, prep, and service.
cert_iso22000_desc: End-to-end food safety management across the supply chain, uniting interactive communication, prerequisite programs, and continuous verification.
cert_iso9001_desc: Process-driven quality consistency, documented workflows, root-cause corrective actions, and leadership accountability across all branches.
about_cta_title: Ready to elevate your facility's quality standards?
about_cta_desc: Explore our specialized services or speak directly with our quality team in Riyadh.
services_page_subtitle: Eight integrated quality control, field inspection, and operational excellence services built for modern food facilities.
workflow_subtitle: A repeatable four-stage cycle from initial assessment to continuous branch compliance.
workflow_1_desc: Evaluate current kitchen, storage, hygiene, and documentation workflows against regulatory and ISO/HACCP benchmarks.
workflow_2_desc: Configure tailored digital checklists, corrective rules, and branch-specific food safety action plans inside the Istqrar platform.
workflow_3_desc: Conduct scheduled weekly or monthly unannounced and planned visits with immediate on-the-floor staff training.
workflow_4_desc: Deliver detailed scoring reports, root-cause tracking, and executive visibility across every branch.
svc_1_desc: A centralized digital platform to monitor branch compliance scores, track audit histories, manage corrective tickets, and review real-time performance dashboards.
svc_1_del_3: Role-based access for admins, managers, and auditors
svc_1_audience: Multi-branch restaurants, cafes, central kitchens, and franchise operators.
svc_2_desc: Scheduled weekly or monthly on-site inspections performed by certified food safety observers to verify hygiene, temperature control, and operational readiness.
svc_2_del_1: Consistent field visit cadence (1 to 4+ visits/month)
svc_2_del_2: Objective scoring by certified third-party observers
svc_2_del_3: Verified GPS check-in & structured criteria grading
svc_2_audience: Food & beverage venues seeking steady, reliable oversight without hiring full-time QA staff.
svc_3_desc: Systematic identification of recurring operational bottlenecks, food waste drivers, and non-compliance gaps with clear remediation steps.
svc_3_del_1: Root-cause analysis of critical & recurring errors
svc_3_del_2: Prioritized corrective action plans per branch
svc_3_audience: Facilities experiencing inconsistent branch quality, customer complaints, or high operational waste.
svc_4_desc: Hands-on preparation and implementation of ISO 9001, ISO 22000, and HACCP prerequisite programs tailored to your kitchen and supply workflow.
svc_4_audience: Enterprises pursuing formal certification or institutional catering contracts.
svc_5_desc: Practical, on-the-spot coaching for chefs, stewards, and branch supervisors during live monitoring visits to fix habits immediately.
svc_5_del_1: Live demonstration of hygiene & handling standards
svc_5_audience: Hospitality teams with high staff turnover or newly opened branches.
svc_6_desc: Comprehensive, structured post-visit reports summarizing earned scores, critical errors, photographic evidence, and actionable recommendations.
svc_6_audience: Operations directors, franchise owners, and branch managers needing clear accountability.
svc_7_desc: A complete, customized food safety blueprint covering receiving, cold-chain storage, preparation, allergen control, and sanitation schedules.
svc_7_del_2: Receiving, thawing, and hot/cold holding protocols
svc_7_audience: New openings, central kitchens, and brands standardizing across multiple cities.
svc_8_desc: Independent, unbiased third-party auditing that gives brand owners and partners an accurate, conflict-free view of true branch performance.
svc_8_audience: Franchise networks, investors, and multi-partner hospitality groups.
subscriptions_page_subtitle: Flexible quality management and field inspection packages designed to scale with your branches and team.
tier_starter_desc: Essential digital monitoring and monthly inspection for single-location cafes and restaurants.
tier_growth_desc: Balanced bi-weekly field oversight and multi-user access for growing multi-branch brands.
tier_enterprise_desc: Full weekly field coverage, staff training, and dispute resolution for high-volume chains.
comparison_subtitle: Compare platform users, field visits, reporting, and support across all three plans.
faq_1_q: Can we customize a package for more than 10 branches?
faq_1_a: Yes. Our Enterprise tier supports additional services tailored to your facility count and operational size. Submit a request and our team will prepare a custom proposal.
faq_2_q: How soon do field visits start after subscribing?
faq_2_a: Once your company and branches are onboarded on the Istqrar platform, our certified quality observers schedule your baseline visit within the first week.
faq_3_q: Are reports available in both Arabic and English?
faq_3_a: Yes. Both the Istqrar dashboard and detailed visit reports support full Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) experiences.
faq_4_q: Can we upgrade our package as we open new branches?
faq_4_a: You can upgrade at any time or add additional users and branch quotas directly through your account manager.
contact_page_subtitle: Connect with our food safety consultants and support team in Riyadh for audits, platform demos, or custom packages.
dept_audits_desc: Schedule baseline assessments, monthly observer visits, or third-party compliance audits.
dept_plans_desc: Get help choosing the right subscription tier for your branches and user count.
dept_support_desc: Assistance with company dashboards, tickets, checklists, or inspector accounts.
